{#
  llms-full.txt — the full prose of the essays and projects in one file.

  llms.txt makes the point that these pages are scrollytelling: the argument
  is carried by visualisations as much as by prose, and a crawler that renders
  no JavaScript sees less than a reader does. This file is the other half of
  that claim — the text itself, extracted from the published HTML by
  pelican/prose.py, so a machine reader never has to execute anything.

  Sections are emitted once each: several PROJECTS entries point at pages the
  APORIA list already covers, and those repeats are dropped.
#}
{% set ns = namespace(seen=[], skipped=[]) -%}
# Crow Intelligence — full text

> The complete readable prose of every Aporia essay and every research project
> published at {{ SITEURL }}/. Extracted from the published pages, with markup,
> navigation and embedded data payloads removed. Companion to
> {{ SITEURL }}/llms.txt, which is the index.

Generated from the site source. Where a page's substance lives in an
interactive visualisation, the prose below is what remains when that
visualisation is removed — it is the floor, not the ceiling.

Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/).
DOIs for the essays and packages are pending; each entry below carries a
TODO-DOI marker in their place.
